# Bark in the Yard

> Bark in the Yard is an international collective working across contemporary visual culture, urban art, critical practice and collective action.

## Identity

- Founded: 2005
- Practice: Contemporary Visual Culture
- Canonical home: https://www.barkintheyard.com/
- Geography: Worldwide, with activity across Africa, Europe and the Indian Ocean
- Slogan: "Future, power, primitive, raw."
- Contact: gun@barkintheyard.com

The collective explores concealment and the dichotomy between interior and exterior spaces, the act of looking in a media-saturated environment, social and generational identity, counterculture movements and contemporary lifestyles. Its work investigates globally connected realities and the interpretative frameworks through which people experience and act in places, spaces and communities.

Working methods include urban art, photography, moving image, zines, posters, sound-image work, participatory projects, socially engaged art, digital culture, design and visual communication. The collective also works in forms that do not yet have a settled name.
